appearance.extreme: Ridges of bone run the backs of both hands and out along the forearms, dry and yellowed. They can't make a fist without them showing.
appearance.obvious: Points of bone have come through the skin over every knuckle, worn smooth and yellow.
appearance.subtle: Their knuckles are heavy and knotted.

description: Calcified projections have erupted through your knuckles. Unarmed attacks deal more damage and cause bleeding.
name: Bone Spurs
